svg.title: Task 401 · Safety verification matrix worksheet
svg.desc: Spreadsheet view of Task 401 · Safety verification matrix, generated from requirements/SYS-*.yaml.
svg.text: The system shall inhibit leg actuation until pilot station readiness
conditions (restraint fastened, hatch secured, controls neutral, exclusion
The system shall provide an operator-requested protective stop with a
defined, analyzed safe behavior for each operating mode that does not
The UAV shall be prevented from rotor startup while mechanically
retained, except under an approved maintenance procedure.
The system shall detect loss or staleness of essential actuator and
posture feedback and transition to a documented degraded state.
The docking interface shall report a positively confirmed
retained/unretained state derived from independent sensing.
UAV launch and recovery shall be inhibited outside a verified operational
envelope of walker posture, motion and dock state.
The walker shall provide lockable isolation and verifiable dissipation of
stored hydraulic pressure before maintenance access.
The walker shall limit commanded motion and payload to a verified static
and dynamic stability envelope, including a terrain slope limit of 20
degrees with the centre of mass no more than 0.12 m ahead of the stance
foot, and provide pilot protection in a fall or overturn.
The walker shall hold its posture without supply or command on loss of
actuator supply, with load holding engaging in less than the free-fall time
The protective stop path shall achieve its defined safe behavior without
depending on the mission, motion and balance control software.
The protective stop shall begin its defined safe behavior within the
reaction time allocated by hazard analysis for each operating mode.
UAV rotor arming shall require a positively confirmed unretained dock
state reported over the docking interface.
On loss of the integration link the UAV shall hold for a set time and then
land in place, and shall not return to the dock or descend within the pilot
keep-out without a recovery permit from the integration manager.
If the series-hybrid power alternative is retained, the walker shall isolate
the traction battery on cell over-temperature, over-voltage or over-current
independently of the motion controller, and warn the pilot.
If the series-hybrid power alternative is retained, a protective stop or
detected fall shall shut off fuel to the engine-generator and stop the
Each ankle actuator shall deliver at least 1.5 m g L_foot of torque at full
actuator supply and at least 0.6 m g L_foot at the supply at which load
holding engages, and each knee actuator at least 22.5 kN m at full supply
(SPEC-WLK-001 mass and geometry), so that a loss of supply inside the
operating envelope does not tip the walker before load holding engages.
The walker shall inhibit walking until both manipulator arms are confirmed
stowed and locked, or locked in the carry pose under the loaded-walking
conditions of SYS-019, shall hold the arms in that pose until walking has
stopped, and shall inhibit manipulation while the exclusion zone around the
arms' reach is not confirmed clear.
The walker shall provide a controlled lowered posture for ingress and
egress, with the cockpit floor at or below a defined height, entered and left
at a controlled speed only while the area under and around the pod and
legs is confirmed clear, and shall inhibit walking while an access ladder is
The walker shall permit walking with a payload only while the payload is
confirmed secured, both arms are locked in a defined carry pose and
payload mass and centre of gravity are within defined limits, and shall then
limit walking speed, step height and terrain slope to defined loaded values
inside the stability envelope of SYS-008.
The pilot shall be able to leave the walker from the standing posture
without platform power and without kneeling, through an exit other than the
front opening, with a descent aid and handholds that keep three points of
The pilot display shall mark UAV imagery, position and telemetry as not
valid when they fail validity checks, and as not current when they have
not updated within a defined time, so that they are never shown as current
and valid when they are not.
The dock shall charge the UAV battery only when the aircraft is seated
and confirmed, shall stop charging on over-voltage, over-current or
over-temperature independently of the charging software, and shall keep
its charging contacts de-energised and shrouded whenever no UAV is
seated or charging has been isolated for handling.

g.text: Terms: AI = artificial intelligence (here, an AI assistant drafting at independence level I0) · BMS = battery management system · F-nnn = system function in the item definition · HAZ-nnn = hazard record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) ·

I0–I3 = review independence level (I0 none, e.g. the author or an AI, to I3 independent organisation) · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 · SPEC-nnn = simulation parameter spec record

(sim/spec/) · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · SUS-GSE = ground support, maintenance supports, charging and test equipment · SUS-I1-INT = integration manager and PX4 command adapter · SUS-M1-CTL = mission, motion and balance control ·

SUS-M1-DCK = UAV dock, retention, charging and release · SUS-M1-MAN = manipulation arms and end effectors · SUS-M1-PIL = pilot station, restraints, displays and controls · SUS-M1-PWR = power generation, storage, distribution and thermal

control · SUS-M1-PWR-BAT = battery pack, BMS and contactors (alternative B) · SUS-M1-PWR-GEN = engine-generator and governor (alternative B) · SUS-M1-SAF = independent safety monitor, protective stop and isolation · SUS-M1-WLK = chassis,
legs, joint actuators and stability sensing · SYS-nnn = system safety requirement record (requirements/SYS-nnn.yaml) · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone) · VER-nnn = verification record or case
